description: This file defines an interface for dispatching actions within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It includes template structures for dispatching elements and a specific interface IDispatch that provides an Identifier method.

classes.name: IDispatch
classes.description: An external interface inheriting from IDispatchType<void> that provides an Identifier method returning a string representation of the class name.

methods.name: Identifier
methods.description: Returns a string identifier for the dispatch object, based on its class name.
